name: dispatch-voice-client-tests
//: Not a build step: the add-on ships vanilla ES modules (src/dispatch_voice/static/) that DisPatch serves under /ext/voice/. This file exists so `node --test` imports those modules directly as ESM. Nothing under static/ imports it.
